title: qos_contention 10000ms.png is byte-identical to 01000ms.png — the T2 wave's third capture is a periodic phase-repeat, not a later state
evidence:
c5.patch: "diff --git a/goldens/qos_contention/01000ms.png b/goldens/qos_contention/01000ms.png
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3c26f46" and "diff --git a/goldens/qos_contention/10000ms.png b/goldens/qos_contention/10000ms.png
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3c26f46" (03000ms.png = 42d495d). sha1sum: 01000ms.png and 10000ms.png both 287891d8740dd4ab94d483d48916020b6042d256; 03000ms.png = d8b0fb3a943e945c7be22ea963805eec5f205155. Trace of the run: tick 20 and tick 200 both show 13 packets with the identical render-visible key multiset (fp 0000000000000000 x5, 0000000000001400 x1, 0000010000000000 x1, 0000010080000100 x1, 0000010100000000 x5). `./bin/harness run` reproduces every frame byte-for-byte (12/12 demos PASS).
detail: The saturated pipe-0 lanes settle into a deterministic periodic orbit, so the render at tick 200 (10000ms) equals tick 20 (1000ms) while tick 60 differs. The demo comment promises captures at 1000/3000/10000ms showing the pile; the third frame adds no new information and can read as a copy-paste error. No AC is violated (all frames show the queue pile + lanes; drops are pinned in T1).
recommended_fix: Optional: pick capture times outside the orbit phase-repeat (e.g. 2000/6000/11000ms) or drop the 10000ms capture, and note the periodic steady state in demos/qos_contention.dem's comment.

title: Spec's 'catalog_hash header re-bless is the only T1 shift' understates the mechanism: ODN-11 folds catalog_hash into every per-tick hash, so light-demo .t1 per-tick lines all shift
evidence: spec-3-3-contention.md: "Determinism spine: array-only walks, integer math, no new serialized fields; existing light demos' T1 stays byte-identical (catalog_hash header re-bless is the only T1 shift)." core/serialize.odin state_writer: "w_u64(&w, state.catalog_hash)" and the comment "the only shift is the deliberate balance.json content addition, which ODN-11 folds into catalog_hash" (the fold predates this PR — present at base 038c2b5, line 88). c5.patch win.t1 hunk: "@@ -3,65 +3,65 @@" with "-catalog_hash c403567796188e5b" / "+catalog_hash afe505119369d195" and every per-tick line changed. Byte-verification: re-running win at head, patching the old catalog_hash into each tick's serialized stream, reproduces the base golden 60/60 ("tick 001 patched=d9fd5b2508083a47 base=d9fd5b2508083a47 OK ... mismatches=0/60 ZERO SIM CHANGE").
detail: The per-tick shift is fully accounted (the catalog binding), but the spec wording implies only the header line moves, which is mechanically impossible given the fold. The imprecise phrase invites future rounds to mis-file win.t1's all-line shift as unaccounted drift.
recommended_fix: Amend the spec sentence to: 'existing light demos' T1 stays byte-identical (the only shift is the per-tick catalog_hash binding, ODN-11) + genuine contention', so the re-bless wording matches the mechanism.
